positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Participated in rotational engineering program.

Global Equity Derivatives - Data Delivery
-Led front-end development and testing of metadata management application using React, Redux, Apollo Client, Jest, and React Testing Library that saved 2+ hours per manual data entry for BAs.
-Created RESTful audit log service using Spring Boot and Spring Data, which is utilized by all of Global Equity Derivatives teams to create an audit trail of Mongo database usage.

Veritas API Store
-Developed billing process from end-to-end using Postgres, gRPC, Go, and React that allowed TD Securities’ APIs to generate revenue for the first time.
-Implemented and tested backend features in Go and UI features in React for application which allows users to start up a new API or application in under 30 minutes and add features such as OAuth, usage tracking, billing, etc.

Treasury and Balance Sheet Management
-Implemented features for application that sits in front of a Spark/HDFS infrastructure that allows users unfamiliar with these tools to execute SQL rules for large files, reducing execution time from several hours to several minutes.
-Automated the process of transferring files from HDFS to Windows using a Java tool.

positions.title: Engineering and Operations Intern
positions.description:
Redesigned the portal technicians use to be more user-friendly using React.
Developed a customizable web portal for AT&T teams using Adobe ColdFusion.

positions.title: Digital Technology Intern
positions.description:
Created automated serverless script in C# that destroys all resource groups in parallel in a subscription in Microsoft Azure which was previously done manually.
Developed a QA script in Go using AWS Lambda to check if customers’ AWS accounts are built correctly that saves team around 6 hours per account.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Converted company-wide travel request application from a Lotus Notes system to Google App Maker application.
Evaluated Google App Maker as a future tool for Colgate-Palmolive to build applications and presented findings to senior management.
Wrote JavaScript scripts to implement features such as a workflow system, database integration, Google integration, etc.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Developed lesson plans and taught students ages 7-18 about programming in Java, game design, and programming game modifications in Minecraft.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Tutored students ages 6-17 in mathematics and helped develop lesson plans.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Helped plan summer conference and national application development program.
Taught application development classes on Windows App Studio and Visual Studio.
Worked in team setting to plan technology events, which reached over 1000 students.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Organized iPod drives and donations to over 100 patients with dementia.
Coordinated activities between volunteers, nursing home staff, and patients.
Planned university-wide community service events that reached over 2000 students.

projects.title: Traverse Metz Ionic Application
projects.description:
Worked with the Metz, FR Tourist Office to develop an Ionic application that allows tourists to create
quick, self-made itineraries. Utilized Google Firebase and Google APIs.

projects.title: Big Bio Data Recapture
projects.description: Developed multi-step algorithm that distinguishes and extracts panels from figures in research papers utilizing Python libraries such as Pytesseract and OpenCV.
